name: iris-wipe
title: Iris Wipe
desc: An old-cartoon iris closes on the subject, holds a beat as a dot, then opens on the next scene.

name: isometric-build
title: Isometric Build
desc: An isometric tile grid springs up row by row into a stepped block sculpture with one accent tower, then holds.

name: italic-speed
title: Italic Speed
desc: A slanted caps word rides in on speed strips with a serif italic subtitle under an underline.

name: keep-words
title: Keep Words
desc: Three serif lines, "Written. Yours. On time.", each ending with a red full stop.

name: kerning-snap
title: Kerning Snap
desc: Loose letters snap to correct kerning one by one in a gradient serif word.

name: keycap-press
title: Keycap Press
desc: Two 3D keycaps press Cmd and K under the line Everything, one shortcut away.

name: keystroke
title: Keystroke
desc: Physical keycaps rise in for each shortcut, press in real order with the modifiers held while the letter taps, spring back with a small capped overshoot, and leave after an idle hold, firing on the same frames as the remocn-ui steps they trigger.

name: kill-feed
title: Kill Feed
desc: A kill-feed of eliminations builds to a big gradient 'PENTA SHIP' banner.

name: kinetic-center-build
title: Kinetic Center Build
desc: A word appears in the center; each new word enters from the right and pushes the line until the full phrase locks centered.

name: kinetic-morph-text
title: Kinetic Morph Text
desc: Letters lift, rotate, and softly reshape into editable phrases with sampled outline trails.

name: kinetic-warp
title: Kinetic Warp
desc: A coarse mesh warp bends a whole word in staccato beats, one axis per keyframe.

name: known-terms
title: Known Terms
desc: Definitions, "A scene is a component ...", build to a green "Your launch is a deploy.".

name: ko-count
title: Ko Count
desc: A knockout count ends in a full-frame gradient slam, 'KNOCKOUT', with a serif subline.

name: landing-confirmed
title: Landing Confirmed
desc: A descent counts down then a big gradient 'SHIPPED.' lands over a serif 'Nailed the landing.'.

name: launch-anything
title: Product Showcase
desc: An independent 26.7-second editorial product film with forest-green accents, original photography, seven editable demos, and geometric marks.

name: launch-date
title: Launch Date
desc: A calendar month draws itself, days sweep on and the launch date glows in a ring.

name: launch-days
title: Launch Days
desc: Vertical day tabs expand one into a big card, '03 Templates', under a Launch Week header.

name: layered-cutout
title: Layered Cutout
desc: The camera dollies through layered cut sheets to land on a framed Remocn logo.

name: layout-guides
title: Layout Guides
desc: Dashed column guides drop over a grid, one column fills and gets a label, a gutter is measured and a now line slides across.

name: layout-swap
title: Layout Swap
desc: Headlines swap by shifting layout, ending 'Animations, transitions and backgrounds, ready to install.'.

name: layover
title: Layover
desc: A headline's key word cycles through a short list of stops before settling on the final word.

name: leaderboard-climb
title: Leaderboard Climb
desc: A launch leaderboard ranks ten products and the highlighted row climbs the table.

name: lean-count
title: Lean Count
desc: A heavy italic figure leans into place as it counts up to 3.2 followed by a red cross.

name: led-ticker
title: Led Ticker
desc: REMOCN IS LIVE scrolls on a retro LED dot-matrix with a gradient on the last word.

name: lens-zoom
title: Lens Zoom
desc: A hard cut disguised as a lens punch-in: barrel distortion, zoom blur, chromatic split and camera shake around the splice.

name: less-more
title: Less More
desc: 'Less explaining.' dims while 'More showing.' lands in bright blue below it.

name: letter-gate
title: Letter Gate
desc: The camera pushes into a giant letter pair, the gap opens like a gate onto the next scene.

name: letter-relay
title: Letter Relay
desc: Letters hop in sequence, each taking off as the previous one lands, to spell the wordmark.

name: level-up
title: Level Up
desc: 'LEVEL UP' ticks from one level to the next, 42, with an XP bar and a stat chip.

name: life-grid
title: Life Grid
desc: Conway's Game of Life plays out on a seeded grid, with newborn cells flashing in the accent.

name: light-burn-to-line
title: Light Burn to Line
desc: Light burns the scene down to a line that opens onto "Now ship your first film.".

name: light-leak
title: Light Leak
desc: A warm analog light leak drifts in from an edge and blows the frame out to near-white at the cut, then cools off to reveal the next scene.

name: light-signature
title: Light Signature
desc: A red horizontal light streak flares as the remocn wordmark appears under 'The all-new'.

name: light-trail-write
title: Light Trail Write
desc: A point of light writes the Remocn wordmark path with a cooling trail.

name: lights-out
title: Lights Out
desc: Five lights go out and a heavy italic headline slams in, with a blue period.

name: line-boil
title: Line Boil
desc: A hand-drawn outline boils like a cel animation, redrawn every few frames with a varying pen weight, then fills with color while it keeps boiling.

name: line-by-line-slide
title: Line-by-Line Slide
desc: Each line enters from the left with a staggered slide and exits to the right for a flowing paragraph reveal.

name: line-cascade
title: Line Cascade
desc: A huge 240 is drawn from cascading gradient lines with a caption below.

name: line-relief
title: Line Relief
desc: Huge LAUNCH lettering is relief-ruled by stacked horizontal lines over a dusk gradient.

name: liquid-fill
title: Liquid Fill
desc: A drop falls into an outlined mark and liquid rises with a sloshing, damping surface and bubbles until the mark is solid.

name: liquid-word
title: Liquid Word
desc: A word melts into a gradient pool, then a new word rises out of it.

name: live-activity
title: Live Activity
desc: A lock-screen live activity shows a render progress bar and remaining time.

name: live-code-compilation
title: Live Code Compilation
desc: Split-screen where typed code on the left snaps a live UI preview on the right, HMR-style.

name: live-dashboard
title: Live Dashboard
desc: A payments dashboard animates its stats, chart and recent activity feed.

name: live-ticker
title: Live Ticker
desc: A big comma-separated counter rolls its digits up like a live ticker with a feed above.

name: log-rescale
title: Log Rescale
desc: A bar chart rescales to a log axis so the final 2.4M bar stands out.

name: logo-construct
title: Logo Construct
desc: A blueprint grid draws the logo construction lines and the wordmark inks in.

name: logo-enter
title: Logo Enter
desc: A stacked group of round brand chips that spring in one-by-one, then hold. Swap the logos to feature any set of marks. Horizontal or vertical stacking.

name: long-shadow
title: Long Shadow
desc: A flat icon casts a long shadow to the frame edge, then the light swings and the shadow sweeps around on a spring.

name: long-vowel
title: Long Vowel
desc: A serif word stretches one vowel, 'Waaaaaay', in a warm gradient with an italic caption.

name: looks-like-this
title: Looks Like This
desc: "Your next launch looks like this." above a Remocn Studio screenshot tile.

name: loop-break
title: Loop Break
desc: A loop of "Render the cut. Spot a typo." breaks into "Change one word. Done.".

name: lumen-count
title: Lumen Count
desc: A glowing 200 counts up with a soft floor reflection and a caption beneath.

name: macro-click
title: Macro Click
desc: A site-builder UI in macro: a cursor clicks and the page headline and hero fill in.

name: macro-letter-pan
title: Macro Letter Pan
desc: The camera pans in macro across letters to land the phrase "Ready to launch.".

name: macro-pan
title: Macro Pan
desc: A serif headline is revealed by a close-up pan across its glyphs, ending on a gradient.

name: macro-tab-name
title: Macro Tab Name
desc: A macro-zoomed tab chip reads "Launch Assets" as a cursor moves in and clicks.

name: magnet-letters
title: Magnet Letters
desc: A wrong word is repelled by magnet and the right word drops in: 'Launch videos, in code.'.

name: magnitude-push
title: Magnitude Push
desc: A huge 1000x pushes in with a blue gradient and a caption, '...fewer keyframes to set by hand'.

name: marker-highlight
title: Marker Highlight
desc: Colored marker block draws behind a phrase as the text color shifts.

name: mask-reveal-up
title: Mask Reveal Up
desc: Lines reveal upward with a soft masked feel and compact stagger.

name: matrix-decode
title: Matrix Decode
desc: Random scramble resolves left-to-right into the target text.

name: max-q
title: Max Q
desc: Speed and altitude figures climb together beside a rising trajectory curve.

name: measure-dim
title: Measure Dim
desc: A gradient bar is measured by dimension lines as 184 fps overtakes 60 fps.

name: menu-pick
title: Menu Pick
desc: A choose-your-launch menu dims two options and highlights the third on a red bar.

name: message-bubble
title: UI Message Bubble
desc: A chat message bubble whose hidden/visible state is a pure function of the timeline. The renderer is a pure function of a MessageBubbleStyle (opacity, translateY, scale); useMessageBubbleTransition eases the rise-in enter. The incoming/outgoing variant resolves bubble color and alignment from the theme, and an optional reaction badge pops in on its own channel.
